title: Degree of normalized Fourier coefficients
statement: For any $n\ge 0$ and any function $p:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, the numerical degree of the coefficient function $T\mapsto\bigl(\mathbf{1}_{\{T=\varnothing\}}-(-2)^{|T|}\sum_{S\supseteq T}\widehat p(S)\bigr)/2$ equals the Fourier degree of $p$.
